title: Detail blog
lede: Editorial clarity with a technical edge.
summary: Ruled article lists, large headings, and monospaced details.

evidence.note: Live page observed; local screenshot saved.

styles.note: Editorial hierarchy with the precision of a technical index.

observed: Large black sans-serif headings contrast with small monospaced dates and labels.
Horizontal rules divide a vertical list of posts.
Square outlined buttons and arrow marks make actions explicit.
White and pale gray dominate; saturated green and cyan punctuate the page.
interpretation: The page borrows the order of an instrument panel while retaining the space and scale of an editorial layout. This is the polished end of the collection.
borrow: A strong heading hierarchy, dated rows, thin separators, and compact action labels. Treat the accent color as emphasis, not a requirement.
